map.新闻发布会流程时间表自动生成: Automatic generation of a press conference run-of-show timetable
map.📖 查看「发布会流程表 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'Press Conference Run of Show'
map.📚 深度解析：发布会流程表: 📚 Deep Dive: Press Conference Run of Show
map.发布会筹备时，选模板（产品/媒体/年会）或自定义，逐环节填名称、时长(分钟)、内: When preparing a press conference, choose a template (product/media/annual meeting) or customise it, and fill in the name, duration (minutes), content and owner for each segment to generate the run of show.
map.按总时长倒推开始时间：已知结束 Deadline 时，用总时长反算各环节应几点启: Back-calculate the start time from the total duration: when the end deadline is known, use the total duration to work out what time each segment should start.
map.多场活动复用同一模板时，微调某环节时长看总时长是否仍在场地档期内。: When reusing the same template for multiple events, fine-tune a segment duration to see whether the total still fits the venue's time slot.
map.流程 = 若干环节，每环节含 名称 / 时长(分钟) / 内容描述 / 负责人；: The run of show = a number of segments, each containing name / duration (minutes) / content description / owner; total duration = the sum of the segment durations; default start time 14:00. Segments can be moved up/down, deleted, or loaded from a template (product contains 10 segments: sign-in 30, warm-up 5, hosting 5, leader remarks 10, product launch 20, product demo 15, guest speech 15, media Q&A 20, group photo 5, tea break 30).
map.套用产品发布会模板：10 个环节时长相加 30+5+5+10+20+15+15+: Applying the product launch template: the ten segment durations sum to 30+5+5+10+20+15+15+20+5+30 = 155 minutes (about 2 hours 35 minutes). Starting at the default 14:00, it ends at an expected 16:35, which falls within a conventional half-day venue slot. If it needs to be compressed to within 2 hours, the tea break 30 and the guest speech 15 can be cut (saving 45 minutes → 110 minutes), but that sacrifices the interaction and media lead-capture segments, so a trade-off is needed.
map.模板里的时长是硬标准吗？: Are the durations in the template hard standards?
map.不是。模板是行业常见节奏的参考值，实际应按嘉宾档期、场地转场、直播信号切换等调整: No. The template gives reference values for common industry pacing; in practice it should be adjusted for guest schedules, venue transitions, live stream signal switching and so on. The value of this tool is to structure 'segment - duration - owner', so the total duration is summed in real time and the start time can be back-calculated, avoiding overruns caused by scheduling from experience alone.
map.为什么总时长要单独看，而不只看环节数？: Why look at the total duration separately instead of only the segment count?
map.环节数相同、时长可以差很多（如 10 个 5 分钟环节 vs 10 个 20 分: The number of segments can be the same while the durations differ greatly (e.g. ten 5-minute segments versus ten 20-minute segments). Media Q&A, tea breaks and demos are often duration black holes; this tool lists the durations explicitly and sums them precisely to expose these 'invisible big items', making it easier to cut or parallelise them.
